sponsoredBills.summary: Authorizes the President to impose sanctions on foreign persons and entities involved in producing, distributing, or facilitating the proliferation of illicit synthetic narcotics from China. sponsoredBills.summary: Establishes research grant programs and demonstration projects for developing hot dry rock geothermal energy technology, including high-temperature equipment development, field testing sites, and milestone-based grants. Authorizes funding for risk assessment research, workforce training programs, and groundwater monitoring related to geothermal development.
sponsoredBills.title: Hot Rock Act

sponsoredBills.summary: Amends the Employee Retirement Income Security Act of 1974 to designate pharmacy benefit managers as fiduciaries, requiring them to disclose compensation and prohibiting indemnification for breaches of fiduciary duties.
sponsoredBills.title: To amend the Employee Retirement Income Security Act of 1974 to ensure that pharmacy benefit managers are considered fiduciaries, and for other purposes.

latestAction.text: Referred to the Committee on Energy and Commerce, and in addition to the Committee on Ways and Means, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.

sponsoredBills.summary: Amends Medicare and Medicaid to require prescription drug plans and pharmacy benefit managers to reimburse in-network pharmacies based on national average drug acquisition costs plus a percentage or fixed amount, pass manufacturer rebates to patients at point of sale, prohibit steering toward specific pharmacies, and submit annual compliance certifications.
sponsoredBills.title: Pharmacists Fight Back in Medicare and Medicaid Act

latestAction.text: Ordered to be Reported (Amended) by the Yeas and Nays: 40 - 2.

sponsoredBills.summary: Amends federal employee health benefit plan requirements to mandate that pharmacy benefit managers reimburse in-network pharmacies based on drug acquisition costs plus a percentage or fixed amount, pay state Medicaid dispensing fees, and apply manufacturer rebates to reduce patient cost-sharing. Prohibits PBMs from steering patients to affiliate pharmacies or restricting pharmacy network participation. Establishes civil penalties and debarment procedures for violations.
sponsoredBills.title: Pharmacists Fight Back [in Federal Employee Health Benefit Plans Act]

latestAction.text: Forwarded by Subcommittee to Full Committee by Voice Vote.

sponsoredBills.summary: Requires application distribution providers to request users declare their age and provide developers of age-differentiated apps technical ability to access age signals. Obligates developers of covered applications to determine user age with reasonable certainty, prevent minors from accessing adult-only content, obtain parental consent where required, and prohibit personalized advertising to minors.
sponsoredBills.title: Parents Over Platforms Act

sponsoredBills.summary: Amends section 230 of the Communications Act to require interactive computer service providers to implement reasonable processes for addressing cyberstalking and intimate privacy violations, including content removal within 48 hours of valid notice. Expands the TAKE IT DOWN Act to cover sexually explicit deepfakes and cyberstalking content.
sponsoredBills.title: Deepfake Liability Act
